# rocelet resources and timing

*Generated by `synth/report.py` from `make synth` and `make synth-variants` (Vivado 2025.2, 2026-10-21).*

Out-of-context results on **xcku5p-ffvb676-2-e** (the KCU116 device) with the clock at the 100G CMAC user clock, **322.265625 MHz (3.103 ns)**, unless noted. Out of context means no I/O buffers and no optimisation across the IP boundary; in a full design the numbers are usually slightly lower. BRAM36 counts RAMB36 tiles plus half a tile per RAMB18. WNS / WHS: worst setup / hold slack, positive = met.

## v1 configuration

The parameter defaults of `rocelet_top`: 16 QPs, 16 memory windows, READ depth 16, a 256 KB URAM retransmit ring (`RTX_MODE` "RING"), 128 outstanding work requests, RX ICRC check, shared CRC network, HSB builder mode, VLAN, PAUSE, ARP/ICMP, other-traffic ports, counters, 32 KB RX and TX FIFOs, 16 KB other-traffic TX FIFO, AXI4 memory master with a 16 KB read buffer.

| | LUT | FF | BRAM36 | URAM | DSP | WNS / WHS (ns) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| synthesis | 20,919 | 24,882 | 37 | 8 | 0 | 0.214 / 0.010 |
| **placed and routed** | **20,588** | **24,968** | **37** | **8** | 0 | **0.144 / 0.010** |
| share of the KU5P | 9.5 % | 5.8 % | 7.7 % | 12.5 % | 0 | |

Worst routed setup path: 0.144 ns, `u_core/u_rtx/r_act_reg/C` -> `u_core/u_rtx/u_q/g_sync.mem_reg_1/ENARDEN`, 10 logic levels.

**v0.2.0-dev** (2026-10-30, same flow and settings, `rocelet_top` only; the tables below are
still the v0.1 run): placed and routed **20,745 LUT** (+157), **25,040 FF** (+72), 37 BRAM36,
8 URAM, WNS / WHS **0.107 / 0.017 ns**. The additions: the link-loss hold and `LINK_GRACE`
(ack_proc +18 LUT), the duplicate-READ flag (resp_tx +3 LUT), `LINK_GRACE`, status and the
`LINK_DOWN` counter (register file +124 LUT). The worst path is now the counter clear
(`u_regs/clr_cnt_reg` -> counter resets, high fanout, 2 logic levels) at 0.107 ns; the
`u_rtx` response-queue path is unchanged in logic.

## Build options

Synthesis only (the routed v1 top is above). Differences are against the v1 top after synthesis.

| Configuration | LUT | FF | BRAM36 | URAM | WNS (ns) | LUT vs v1 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|
| v1 rocelet_top (all defaults) | 20,919 | 24,882 | 37 | 8 | 0.214 | +0 |
| v1 rocelet_core (engine only, native memory ports) | 14,886 | 12,612 | 7 | 8 | 0.214 | -6,033 |
| RTX_MODE "REREAD" (payload re-read from memory, no ring) | 21,175 | 24,682 | 44.5 | 0 | 0.214 | +256 |
| RTX_MODE "LOSSY" (lossy resume, no payload storage) | 20,636 | 23,488 | 33.5 | 0 | 0.214 | -283 |
| HSB_EN = 0 | 20,862 | 24,836 | 37 | 8 | 0.214 | -57 |
| COUNTERS_EN = 0 | 20,380 | 22,875 | 37 | 8 | 0.105 | -539 |
| RX_ICRC_EN = 0 (rely on the Ethernet FCS) | 17,814 | 23,312 | 37 | 8 | 0.214 | -3,105 |
| COUNTERS_EN = 0, OTHER_EN = 0, VLAN_EN = 0 | 18,685 | 20,055 | 29.5 | 8 | 0.214 | -2,234 |
| v1 at 250 MHz (4.0 ns) | 20,827 | 24,882 | 37 | 8 | 1.111 | -92 |

## Against the research prototype and AMD's ERNIC IP

| Design | LUT | BRAM36 | URAM | Scope |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| **rocelet v0.1 `rocelet_top`** (routed, OOC) | **20,588** | **37** | **8** | engine + MAC glue + ARP/ICMP + register file + counters + AXI4 memory master |
| rocelet v0.1 `rocelet_core` (synthesis, OOC) | 14,886 | 7 | 8 | engine only |
| prototype T2, 256 KB ring, 16 QP (synthesis, OOC) | 15,298 | 6 | 8 | engine only, split CRC network, no HSB / continuation / RNR decode / flush / pacer |
| prototype T2 "RoCE function" in the KCU116 system (routed) | 16,738 | 23 | 8 | engine + MAC glue + ARP/ICMP; 17,335 with the VID-0 and PAUSE logic of the host-interop build; no register file, no AXI master |
| AMD ERNIC v4.3, 8 QP (synthesis, OOC) | 42,082 | 117 | 20 | engine only |

The approved v1 budget for the RoCE function was about 24k LUT (engine with the HSB packetizer, production allowance and MAC glue). rocelet_top, with the register file and the AXI4 memory master that the budget did not include, is 20,588 LUT.

## Reproducing

```
make synth            # lint, v1 top (place and route), v1 core
make synth-variants   # the build options
python3 synth/report.py   # this page
```

`synth/run_synth.sh` waits while two or more Vivado processes run on the machine (`MAX_JOBS`). Reports: `synth/build/<job>_{synth,route}_{util,hier,timing}.rpt`. The Vivado linter (`synth_design -lint`, job `v1_lint`) reports no errors on the v1 top; its warnings are unused ports and signals of disabled options and width notes.
